answer: Trust is federated into islands, and weight crosses an island boundary only when an identity on one island has been endorsed by an identity on another that has no shared path back, so a farm confined to one island cannot export its internal reputation outward. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The umber is the island, the onyx the endorsement that crosses it, and the inlet the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one umber is cheap to hold, but an onyx only counts when no inlet exists, and that takes independent history.
